summary.text: Pakistan U19 scored 275-7 as Ahmed Hussain top-scored with 89 off 73 balls, while Bipin Sharma took 3 for 58. Rohit Chand made 37 off 54 balls in reply for NPLU19 before they were bowled out for 174-10 against Ahmed Hussain, who claimed 4 for 35 to secure a 101-run victory for Pakistan U19.
